## The question

[Is there a good document template for making business cards?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/4693/is-there-a-good-document-template-for-making-business-cards), asked by [Neil G](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/512/neil-g) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-10-29; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> Is there a good document template for making business cards?
:::

You could also just roll your own by making the whole document a `tikzpicture` and placing the text with `\node` commands.
